data.title: Transportation — Starter · Lesson 1
data.subject: transportation
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Here we go

[Hook]
Let's travel… Vamos a viajar
In the red car… En el coche rojo
Ride with me… Viaja conmigo
One, two, let's go… Uno, dos, ¡vámonos!

[Verse]
Waking up, feeling free,
Time to move, just you and me.
Good morning… Buenos días
The day is calling us.
Thank you… Gracias
For this adventure.
Out the door, we make our way,
To the station, let's not delay.
Wait for the train… Esperar el tren
Hear the whistle, here it comes again.

[Hook]
Let's travel… Vamos a viajar
In the red car… En el coche rojo
Ride with me… Viaja conmigo
One, two, let's go… Uno, dos, ¡vámonos!

[Verse]
Down the street, the buses roll,
People coming, people go.
Go by bus… Ir en autobús
See the city, feel the flow.
Taxi cabs, they line the street,
Take a taxi… Tomar un taxi
Quick and easy, can't be beat.
Riding bikes, we feel the breeze,
Ride a bicycle… Montar en bicicleta
Under trees, with such ease.

[Bridge]
Sailing on the water blue,
Navegar en barco, just me and you.
